recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The current source satisfies the seed issue; adding a SimpleQuantity item-type code or restoring valueSimpleQuantity wording would conflict with the accepted modification and later cleanup.
issue_request: FHIR-37468 was Published/Persuasive with Modification. It asked for a way to use Questionnaire quantity questions without permitting comparators; the accepted modification was to make the existing quantity item type always mean SimpleQuantity and to use SimpleQuantity for QuestionnaireResponse quantity answers rather than adding a separate SimpleQuantity item-type code.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites git Questionnaire-fixes 28dd25d341. That commit updated source/questionnaire/codesystem-item-type.xml from comparator-capable Quantity wording to SimpleQuantity answer wording and changed QuestionnaireResponse.item.answer.value[x] in source/questionnaireresponse/structuredefinition-QuestionnaireResponse.xml from Quantity to SimpleQuantity.
additional_context: Questionnaire and QuestionnaireResponse are active, approved resources in source/fhir.ini. Later Applied issue FHIR-41195 completed the same SimpleQuantity cleanup for Questionnaire.item.enableWhen.answer[x], Questionnaire.item.initial.value[x], and the item-type wording; that related issue is already represented on the combined branch and was not duplicated. Zulip and Confluence evidence confirms the comparator rationale and the 2022 persuasive-with-modification vote.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current item-type quantity definition says a Quantity constrained to SimpleQuantity, QuestionnaireResponse.item.answer.value[x] uses SimpleQuantity, and related Questionnaire answer locations and the QuestionnaireResponse answer-quantity search parameter are already consistent.
